answer: A concrete sybil resistance is a bonded harbor where each agent must dock a unique work history vine that grows only with attested answers over time. An attacker spawning many heads must cultivate a separate vine for every fake%2C each requiring the same harbor entry cost and continuous staking%2C so total expense scales with the number of identities while one honest agent maintains a single vine. The hollow space of unattested claims is rejected%2C making mass creation costly and detectable.
